---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it.
e.g. "I often need to do X but there is no way to do that currently."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you have thought about, and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Constraints

Please keep in mind that TreeViewer is intentionally:
- **zero-dependency** (no npm packages, no CDN imports)
- **no-build** (must work by opening `index.html` directly)

If your feature requires a dependency or a build step, please explain why the trade-off is worth it.

## Additional context

Mockups, sketches, links to similar tools, etc.
